note: Rewritten from the species-level description of Chhotani (1997), originally in English; alates not recorded; worker monomorphic. Synonymy list, literature citations, figure numbers and distribution records not translated; the source also contains the account of another species, which was not used.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule, antennae and body cream yellow; rostrum yellowish brown. Head capsule with numerous short setae and one or two pairs of long setae; apex of rostrum with a few short setae; abdominal tergites also with short setae and a few long setae. Body length 3.30–3.75 mm. Head capsule subcircular; length including rostrum 1.43–1.45, length without rostrum 0.83–0.88, maximum width 0.83–0.93 mm; in profile shallowly incurved at the base of the rostrum. Rostrum slender, conical, 0.55–0.62 mm long; slightly shorter than the head length without rostrum, rostrum length/head length index 0.83–0.88. Antennae 12-segmented; segment 3 shortest. Mandibles vestigial, each with a minute spine-like process at midlength. Postmentum 0.33–0.40 long, maximum width 0.25–0.30 mm. Pronotum saddle-shaped; anterior margin with a weak median notch; length 0.24–0.28, maximum width 0.42–0.48 mm. Mesonotum narrower, metanotum wider than pronotum, both subcircular.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Monomorphic. Head pale cream yellow; antennae and body milky white. Body length 3.5 mm. Head subsquare; length to base of mandibles 0.83–0.85, maximum width 0.95–0.98 mm. Antennae 13-segmented; segment 3 shortest. Fontanelle narrow and elongate, semitransparent. Postclypeus inflated, setose, less than half as long as wide. Pronotum saddle-shaped; length 0.25–0.28, width 0.53 mm.
